us008_plan_attestation.meaning: The owner formally attests the preregistered benchmark plan (frozen workloads, sample counts, SHA-256-seeded pair ordering, paired log-ratio statistics, power model, pass thresholds) as of the plan content at mainline 51257ac. The plan is FROZEN by this attestation: no measurement may be tuned, extended, replaced, optionally stopped, or outlier-deleted after the fact. Assurance level stays OWNER_ATTESTED_NOT_INDEPENDENT with independent_review_claimed:false — no independent attestor exists and none is claimed; the owner was shown this labeling in the question and attested under it. The binding record in-repo must digest-bind this attestation to the exact frozen plan bytes.
